title: README Setup claims Node 18+ but node:sqlite requires Node 22.13+
evidence: README.md Setup section says 'Requires Node.js 18 or newer', contradicting the intro and src/app.ts:2 `import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite'` which needs Node >=22.13; a user on Node 18 following Setup would fail at runtime
suggestion: Make the Setup prerequisite say Node.js 22.13 or newer, matching the intro paragraph

title: Tests dispatch handlers off the router stack instead of over HTTP
evidence: tests/app.test.ts:19-39 reaches into `(app as any)._router.stack` and calls handlers directly; express.json() body parsing and the error-handling middleware (src/app.ts:99-102) are never exercised, and supertest is a declared devDependency that goes unused
suggestion: Drive the app through supertest/HTTP so middleware and JSON error handling are covered
